exposure: Surgical approach (extraperitoneal retrograde hysterectomy vs. classical hysterectomy)
cohort: Twelve patients with antenatal diagnosis of placenta accreta spectrum treated with extraperitoneal hysterectomy between 2018 and 2021, compared to a historical cohort who underwent classical hysterectomy between 2007 and 2017.
finding: This study suggests that extraperitoneal retrograde hysterectomy may be associated with reduced blood transfusion rates compared to classical hysterectomy in women with placenta accreta spectrum.
